correctness.rationale: For K_{n,n}, n≥3, with price t on one perfect matching and price 1 otherwise, projection-trace Rayleigh bounds valid for all asymmetric edge weights give λ2≤min{B/(n−1),[2(n−1)A+(n−2)B]/[n(n−1)]}, where tA+B=1. The piecewise-linear envelope maximizes at a=b when t<2(n−1)/(n−2), at A=0 when t>threshold, and over a full interval at equality. Exact block spectrum for orbit-constant weights is 0,2d,nb,2a+(n−2)b with multiplicities 1,1,n−1,n−1. Equality in the second trace bound forces the whole antisymmetric zero-sum space into the λ2 eigenspace; comparison of the two Laplacian blocks forces offmatching weights equal and the diagonal equal, ruling out asymmetric optima. Independent exact rational eigen/projection and threshold checks agree. The optimization is continuous-time Laplacian, not discrete-time SLEM.

value.rationale: A common optimization problem—select conductances on a symmetric bipartite network when a predefined set of links is expensive—has an exact discontinuous structural phase boundary in the unique optimal design. Proving the entire face and excluding asymmetric choices yields a reusable global certificate and a decision rule without numerical semidefinite optimization.
